What happens in the five days.

You hand over the bike on Tuesday morning and you ride it home the next Tuesday. Here is what happens in between, and the one phone call you might get. We look at it with you and write the price on the tag.

Three services, one price each.

The price on the board is the price on your tag. Parts are extra, and we quote them before any work starts, so the bill at collection is never a surprise. Every service ends with a test ride.

Bikes that leave here ready.

Gravel, commuter and children's bikes from three makers. Each one is built and test-ridden by a named mechanic, fitted to you, and checked again free at six weeks, whatever you ride.
